screenshots.name: admin-order-page
screenshots.description: OrderPage with creation buttons (OrderBookModal and WaybillCreationModal) and existing orders table showing status badges, department info, and action buttons

mustContain: order creation buttons and orders table with status badges

screenshots.validationNote: EN shows Order page with data and translation keys (shekveta.*). RU shows same page in Russian. KA identical to admin-order-menu-ka (duplicate). Some untranslated 'shekveta.*' keys visible in EN and RU.

screenshots.name: admin-order-book
screenshots.description: OrderBookModal dual-panel interface showing available items from receiver department inventory on the left and selected items with quantity inputs on the right
screenshots.knownLimitation: Modal requires clicking the OrderBook creation button; available items depend on receiver department inventory data

captureSteps.script: (() => { const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button'); const btn = Array.from(buttons).find(b => b.querySelector('svg') && b.closest('[class*="action"]')); return btn ? 'book button found' : 'searching for first creation button'; })()

captureSteps.description: Click the OrderBook creation button (first action button)

mustContain: dual-panel modal with available items list and selected items panel

screenshots.name: admin-order-waybill
screenshots.description: WaybillCreationModal with header fields (date, document number, departments, order ID, supplier) and item entry section with search, unit, and quantity fields
screenshots.knownLimitation: Modal requires clicking the Waybill creation button; item search requires catalog data to be populated

captureSteps.script: (() => { const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('button'); return 'total buttons: ' + buttons.length; })()

captureSteps.description: Click the Waybill creation button (second action button)

mustContain: waybill form with date, department selects, and item entry fields

screenshots.name: admin-order-confirmation
screenshots.description: OrderConfirmationPage with 3-section layout: item entry form (for active orders), main orders table with inline filter row, and order details expansion area
screenshots.knownLimitation: Item entry form (Section 1) is only visible when an active-status order is selected; page requires existing order data

mustContain: order confirmation page with orders table and filter row

screenshots.name: admin-order-item-entry
screenshots.description: OrderConfirmationItemForm for adding items to active orders, showing search query input with dropdown, unit field, quantity input, and add button
screenshots.docReference: Section 12.6 - OrderConfirmationPage, Section 1: Item Entry Form
screenshots.knownLimitation: Only visible when an order with status 'active' is selected in the orders table; requires active order data to exist

captureSteps.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr'); return 'table rows: ' + rows.length; })()

captureSteps.description: Click the first order row to select it and reveal item entry form

mustContain: item entry form with search input, unit field, and quantity input

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages identical to admin-order-details of same language. Both show expanded order with details but no distinct item entry form visible. The order status is CONFIRMED (not active), so the item entry form is not shown. Needs an active order to reveal the item entry form.

screenshots.name: admin-order-details
screenshots.description: Inline order details expanded below a selected row in the orders table, showing line items with item name, code, unit, and editable quantity fields plus confirm button
screenshots.knownLimitation: Requires clicking an order row to expand details inline; order must have line items to display

captureSteps.description: Click the first order row to expand inline details

captureSteps.script: (() => { const details = document.querySelectorAll('table table, [class*="detail"], [class*="expand"]'); return 'detail elements: ' + details.length; })()

mustContain: expanded order details with line items showing name, code, unit, and quantity

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages show expanded order confirmation with line item details. Content is valid but identical to admin-order-item-entry. This basename is the one that should keep the 'completed' status as it correctly shows the expanded details.

screenshots.name: admin-orders-list
screenshots.description: OrdersPage with flat line item view where each row represents a single item with compound ID, price lookup from warehouse balances, delivered quantity tracking, and remaining quantity
screenshots.knownLimitation: Prices are looked up from warehouse inventory at display time and may show as empty if no inventory data exists

mustContain: flat line item table with price and delivery quantity columns

screenshots.name: admin-order-group
screenshots.description: OrderGroupPage with aggregated order data grouped by document number, showing summary rows with document number, date, departments, and aggregate counts with clickable rows for detail modals
screenshots.knownLimitation: Detail modal requires clicking a group row; grouping requires multiple orders with the same document number

mustContain: grouped orders table with document number, departments, and aggregate data
